candidates.change_summary: Delete the statement `depositsCount++;` so receiving ether no longer increments the deposit counter.
Replace `depositsCount++;` with `depositsCount += 2;` so each deposit increments the counter by two instead of one.
Replace `depositsCount++;` with `depositsCount--;` so each deposit decrements the counter (reverting at zero) instead of incrementing it.
Remove the call to withdraw(address(this).balance) so withdrawAll no longer transfers the contract balance to the owner.
Replace the withdrawn amount with 0 so withdrawAll transfers no ether.
Drop the onlyOwner modifier from withdrawAll so any address can drain the balance.
Invert the access check in onlyOwner so withdrawAll reverts for the owner and succeeds for non-owners.
Removed the `require(msg.sender == owner);` check from the onlyOwner modifier, allowing any caller to execute withdraw/withdrawAll.
Changed the transfer recipient from `msg.sender` to `owner`, so funds go to the owner instead of the caller.
Changed the transfer amount from `_value` to `0`, so no funds are actually transferred out.
Removed the onlyOwner modifier from withdraw so that any address can withdraw arbitrary amounts.
